attributes.title: Level 6

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about using advanced movement animations and music, multi-layer background scrolling and the story extension in your code!

questions.hint: Does an object appear smaller the closer it gets?
questions.title: [Select one] To create the illusion of a Sprite running towards the game camera, the Sprite’s scale should be decreased over time.
questions.correctResponse: Decreasing a sprites scale over time will create the illusion that it is moving further away from the game camera, not towards it.

questions.hint: What type of values does the string parameter pass to the StringPlayable function?
questions.title: [Select one] When creating music with the music.StringPlayable function, the String parameter can create short, 8 -note melodies and longer, more complex melodies.
questions.correctResponse: The string parameter stores notes, represented by letters A -G and a number 1-8 indicating their octave. The temp parameter sets how quickly the string parameter is played to create custom melodies.

questions.hint: Can the vx and vy for each layer be adjusted?
questions.title: [Select one] When creating scrolling backgrounds with multiple layers, all layers must scroll in the same direction.
questions.correctResponse: The vx and vy for each layer can be adjusted, which alters the direction and speed for each individual background layer!

subgroups.title: Advanced Animations, Music and Extensions
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about using advanced movement animations and music, multi-layer background scrolling and the story extension in your code!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 6 of Purple Belt! Before you create your final Purple Belt project, there are a few neat tricks to learn that could take your game to the next level! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 6:

badges.title: Extension Explorer
badges.description: Use animation and music code, plus the scroller and story extensions, to enhance a project.

badges.title: Stop Motion
badges.description: Use an array of images to create an animation for a sprite.

badges.title: Path of Least Resistance
badges.description: Use an animation preset path to animate a sprite’s movement.

badges.title: Earworm
badges.description: Create a custom melody using a string of note names.

badges.title: Seven Layer Dip
badges.description: Use the Scroller extension to change the background image layers.

badges.title: Parallax Party
badges.description: Use the Scroller extension to move a background layer to create a parallax effect.

badges.title: The Choice is Yours
badges.description: Use the Story extension to present the player with choices.

badges.title: Stage Directions
badges.description: Use the Story extension to move a sprite to a specific position.

badges.title: What’s my Line?
badges.description: Use the Story extension to have a sprite say text with custom colors.
